neighbours.label: a time noun naming a span or occasion in which something happens (a period of, a time of day, moments when, the day when); a duration like 'a long time' or a non-time noun in the same frame stays low
fire: The town grew quickly during a period of cheap land and new railways.
Dawn is the time of day when birds sing the loudest.
There are moments when a teacher simply has to stay quiet.
She still remembers the day when the factory finally closed.
History recalls an era when kings ruled without parliaments.
Harvest is a season when farmers barely sleep at all.
The country went through a period of deep economic hardship.
We talked about the years when we lived by the sea.
quiet: The town grew quickly thanks to cheap land and new railways.
The birds in the garden sing loudly and fly off.
There are rules that a teacher simply has to follow.
She still remembers the factory that finally closed.
History recalls a king who ruled without parliament.
Farmers barely sleep at all and work for a long time.
The country went through deep economic hardship.
We talked about the house where we lived by the sea.
